summary: Completed frontend testing for toast removal and iOS action sheets implementation. All Sonner toasts successfully removed and replaced with inline state changes, notice bar for errors, and iOS-style action sheets for confirmations.
passed_tests: Login via API with token storage (localStorage 'voiladi_token' and 'token')
Profile page: VOILADI+ row shows 'Soon' pill and is disabled (no popup possible)
Settings: Logout action sheet with red 'Log Out' button and separate 'Cancel' button
Likes page: Report flow with inline done state ('Thanks for letting us know'), NO toast
Likes page: Block dialog with red destructive action and Cancel button
Edit Profile: Interests limit shows inline red text '10/10 - that's the maximum', NO toast
Edit Profile: Save navigates to /profile with NO 'Profile saved' toast
Dev hooks: window.__voFeedback.banner() shows iOS notification banner at top
Dev hooks: window.__voFeedback.notice() shows notice bar at bottom
Discover page loads with swipe action buttons
NO Sonner toaster elements ([data-sonner-toaster]) found in DOM
All action sheets use iOS-style glass design with red destructive actions

toast_removal_verification.details: All Sonner toast() calls successfully replaced. No [data-sonner-toaster] elements in DOM. No console warnings about toast/sonner.

inline_state_changes.details: Success actions show NO popup. Report shows inline 'Thanks for letting us know' state. Interests limit shows inline red text. Profile save has no toast.

ios_action_sheets.details: Logout, Block, Unmatch, Report dialogs all use iOS-style glass sheets with red destructive actions and separate Cancel button.

notice_bar.details: Thin glass bar appears at bottom for errors (e.g., invalid chat route). Auto-dismisses after ~3s. Positioned above tab bar when present.

ios_banner.details: Realtime notification banner appears at top with iOS glass styling. Tap to dismiss. Dev hook window.__voFeedback.banner() works.

voiladi_plus_row.details: Shows grey 'Soon' pill. Row is disabled (aria-disabled=true), so no click is possible and no popup can appear.
